changes: Selected PA lot auto-fits fully while never zooming in beyond the user's current zoom.
Leaflet modal size is revalidated at 60ms, 180ms and 520ms.
Selected lot is re-fitted after 140ms and 420ms to avoid initial layout clipping.
JUPEM cadastral tile requests use the active state only instead of scope=all.
PA WGS84 auto-detected state updates NDCDB and C3 overlay state.
Transient JUPEM tile failures retry up to four times.
Tile loading avoids zoom-animation request bursts and keeps a three-tile buffer.
PA-BM map search cache-buster bumped to v1116.
